connector.name: MCP Graphql Bridge
connector.registryDescription: Bridges any GraphQL API to Claude Code - auto-generates MCP tools via schema introspection.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-graphql-bridge. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the murilojrpereira account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: GRAPHQL_API_URL
env.description: GraphQL endpoint URL used for executing queries and mutations. Defaults to the public Countries API.

env.name: GRAPHQL_INTROSPECTION_URL
env.description: GraphQL endpoint URL used for schema introspection. Defaults to GRAPHQL_API_URL.

env.name: GRAPHQL_TOKEN
env.description: Bearer token for authenticating query and mutation execution.

env.name: GRAPHQL_INTROSPECTION_TOKEN
env.description: Bearer token for schema introspection. Defaults to GRAPHQL_TOKEN.

env.name: GRAPHQL_MAX_TOOLS
env.description: Maximum number of generated query and mutation tools. Defaults to 128.

env.name: GRAPHQL_INCLUDE_MUTATIONS
env.description: Set to false to disable mutation tools and mutation execution. Defaults to true.

env.name: GRAPHQL_MAX_RETRIES
env.description: Retries for transient upstream responses. Defaults to 0.
